subtitleNullable: 150K employee records for burnout prediction and mental health analysis
descriptionNullable:
🔥 150,000 synthetic records of tech employees across roles, company sizes, and work modes

- Covers full mental health pipeline — work stress, lifestyle, sleep, social support, therapy access
- Three derived mental health scores: stress, anxiety, and depression (all correlated realistically)
- Two targets: burnout_level (Low/Moderate/High classification) + seeks_professional_help (binary)
- Perfect for burnout prediction, mental health EDA, fairness analysis by gender/role/company size

🔗 Starter Notebook — EDA, burnout distribution, feature correlations, baseline classification models
